features: DOES NOT CHANGE THE DATABASE SCHEMA AND REWRITES NO DATA — No migration. Plans already issued stay as they were, and the stops already written in the record of the transfers are not rewritten. The transfers you record from now on save a little more information in their record for the resale of an heir: the part they received with the succession and, if they had also bought a part with a single earlier stop, whom that stop was left with; those already recorded do not have it and are read as before. The beta corrects the stops of transfers that follow one another on the same unit after the end of a lease with «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement) (the creation, the reserve and the extinction of the usufruct on a unit split between full ownership and usufruct; the resale of an heir who had also bought a part; the sale after a stop at the charge of several people), the allocation of a split unit that has a zero-share row closed the day before another row of the same role, and the sentences that said «management» twice.

CHANGED: THE ALLOCATION OF A UNIT SPLIT BETWEEN FULL OWNERSHIP AND USUFRUCT ALSO READS THE ZERO-SHARE ROW — On a unit split between full ownership and usufruct, a role entered with a zero share does not pay: the item goes to the next role in the chain. If its row is closed the day before another row of the same role starts, though, the other row applies from its own start date and not from the start of the period. The allocation of the split unit did not read it: the new row applied from the start of the period, the unit did not come out as split, and the usufructuary also paid the full owner's part; the rest of the calculation already read it. An example: an item of € 1,200.00 entirely on the «Inquilino» (tenant), with no tenant entered; Anna is full owner at 50 %, on the other half Ugo is owner until 30 April and then bare owner, Elsa is usufructuary from 1 May and Zeno is usufructuary with a zero share until 30 April. Before, Anna paid € 197.26 and Elsa € 805.48; now Anna pays € 600.00, Ugo € 197.26 as before (until 30 April) and Elsa € 402.74 (from 1 May). The plans generated or recalculated after the update change; a plan already issued stays as it is.

CHANGED: THE RESALE OF AN HEIR WHO HAD ALSO BOUGHT A PART SAYS AT WHOSE CHARGE THE STOP IS, AND DOES NOT POINT TO THE WALLET — When someone who inherits with the arrears passed to the heirs had also bought a part of the same unit, in the same row as the one received with the succession, that purchase had left a stop, and then they resell, the figure of the stop comes from several origins: the part received with the succession, which is theirs, and the part bought, whose stop was at the charge of whoever sold it to them. Before, the sentence put the whole figure at the heir's charge and pointed to the Wallet. An example: Ugo holds 75 % and Anna 25 %; the end of Ines's lease on 1 July 2026 writes the settlement (the pair of balance rows is € 181.48: € 136.11 is Ugo's and € 45.37 is Anna's); on 1 October Anna sells to Bruno (€ 22.68 stay at Anna's charge); on 15 October Ugo dies, heirs Bruno and Elsa in halves, with the arrears passed to the heirs, and his part of the pair passes to them; on 1 December Bruno resells everything to Carlo. Of the € 19.11 of that resale, € 11.47 comes from the part received with the succession and € 7.64 from the part bought. Now the panel says where the figure comes from («… e con la successione del 15 ottobre 2026 una parte, € 68,06, è passata a Bruno. La vendita del 1 ottobre 2026 non ha spostato la parte di Bruno, € 22,68, rimasta a carico di Anna da regolare a mano.» (… and with the succession of 15 October 2026 a part, € 68.06, passed to Bruno. The sale of 1 October 2026 did not move Bruno's part, € 22.68, which stayed at Anna's charge, to be settled by hand.)) and at whose charge it is: «€ 19,11 restano a carico di Bruno e Anna, o di Bruno se la fermata della vendita del 1 ottobre 2026 è già stata regolata. Se vanno a Carlo, la parte si regola fra le parti: chi la restituisce dipende da come è stata regolata la fermata della vendita del 1 ottobre 2026, e il programma non lo sa.» (€ 19.11 stay at the charge of Bruno and Anna, or of Bruno if the stop of the sale of 1 October 2026 has already been settled. If they go to Carlo, the part is settled between the parties: who gives it back depends on how the stop of the sale of 1 October 2026 was settled, and the program does not know.) It does not point to the Wallet, because the program does not divide the figure between the two origins: each one's share is for you to decide. The reasons that ask for the tick, the history and the «Annulla il conguaglio» (cancel the settlement) warning say the same; with several purchases the sentence states the earlier stops one by one, and the reason says «come non erano passate a Bruno le parti che aveva comprato» (as the parts he had bought had not passed to Bruno). An heir who had bought nothing, or who is the only heir of whoever sold to them, stays as before: the stop is theirs, with the Wallet and the balances linked to the transfer. If instead the part bought is on another row (for example full ownership bought and bare ownership inherited) and the heir resells that one, the figure comes from the purchase alone and the sentence is that of every second sale: at the charge of whoever held the stop of that purchase, or of the heir if that stop has already been settled, without the Wallet; before, it was all at the heir's charge, with the Wallet. The people of an earlier stop are read like the rows of the pair: whoever died with the arrears passed to the heirs left them their row, and with it the stop they had, so the sentence names their heirs and not whoever has a row on the same unit without being part of that stop.

FIX: THE STOP AFTER «SCRIVI IL CONGUAGLIO» ON A UNIT SPLIT BETWEEN FULL OWNERSHIP AND USUFRUCT — After the end of a lease with «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement), the creation, the reserve and the extinction of the usufruct that make a unit split between full ownership and usufruct, or find it split, measured the part to be settled by hand wrongly: the simulation of the transfer did not see the unit as split. An example: Ugo and Anna are owners at 50 %; the end of Ines's lease on 1 July 2026 writes the settlement (€ 181.48, that is € 90.74 each); on 1 October Ugo creates in favour of Elsa the usufruct of his half. The panel said to record from the Wallet € 45.37 credit to Ugo, € 90.74 debit to Elsa and € 45.37 credit to Anna (in the simulation Elsa paid in full and Anna was in credit): following the sentence, Elsa paid double and Anna collected € 45.37 that was not due. Now it says «… la parte di quei giorni dal 1 ottobre 2026 tocca a Elsa, ma il programma non la sposta: € 45,37 restano a carico di Ugo. Se vanno a Elsa, registra dal Wallet i saldi legati a questo passaggio, sulla stessa gestione: € 45,37 a credito di Ugo e € 45,37 a debito di Elsa.» (… the part of those days from 1 October 2026 falls to Elsa, but the program does not move it: € 45.37 stay at Ugo's charge. If they go to Elsa, record from the Wallet the balances linked to this transfer, on the same management: € 45.37 credit to Ugo and € 45.37 debit to Elsa.), and nothing to Anna, who stays full owner of the other half. With the usufruct reserve on the same half the panel gave a stop that did not exist, a credit of € 45.37 for Anna, and now it stops nothing. With the extinction of Ugo's usufruct (Anna full owner, Ugo usufructuary, Elsa bare owner) it said nothing, and € 45.37 stayed with Ugo in silence: now the stop is € 45.37 at Ugo's charge, for Elsa. The transfers that follow also read the right stop: after the extinction, Elsa's sale of 1 November says «€ 30,08 restano a carico di Ugo, o di Elsa se la fermata dell'estinzione dell'usufrutto del 1 ottobre 2026 è già stata regolata» (€ 30.08 stay at Ugo's charge, or Elsa's if the stop of the extinction of the usufruct of 1 October 2026 has already been settled), where before it put them at the charge of Ugo and Anna; after the creation and the sale of the bare ownership to Dora, the extinction of Elsa's usufruct names the stop of the creation with € 45.37, not € 90.74. The same holds with a garage in the same end of lease and with an income chapter in the days of the pair (the rent of an antenna).

FIX: THE SALE AFTER A STOP AT THE CHARGE OF SEVERAL PEOPLE NAMES THE PEOPLE OF THAT STOP — When the earlier stop is at the charge of several people together, the sale that follows put it at the charge of the whole pair, including whoever had nothing to do with that stop. An example: Ugo holds 50 %, Anna 25 % and Bruno 25 %; Elsa buys from Anna on 1 October and from Ugo on 15 October and resells to Carlo on 1 December (€ 22.93 at the charge of Ugo and Anna, who are the people of Elsa's two stops); on 15 December Carlo resells to Dora. Before, the stop of this last sale (€ 12.58) was at the charge of Ugo, Anna and Bruno; now it says «a carico di Ugo e Anna, o di Carlo se la fermata della vendita del 1 dicembre 2026 è già stata regolata» (at the charge of Ugo and Anna, or of Carlo if the stop of the sale of 1 December 2026 has already been settled), and Bruno is not there.

FIX: THE SENTENCES NO LONGER REPEAT «GESTIONE» BEFORE A NAME THAT ALREADY STARTS THAT WAY — «Gestione ordinaria» is the name the program gives to the base management of every new condominium, and the sentences of the transfers wrote «sulla gestione Gestione ordinaria» and «(gestione Gestione ordinaria)» (on the management Gestione ordinaria). Now the word before the name is there only if the name does not already start with «gestione»: «sulla Gestione ordinaria», «sulla gestione Ordinaria 2026», «sulla gestione Tetto». It applies to the «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel of the stops, the reasons that ask for the tick, the unit's history, the «Annulla il conguaglio» warnings, the effects of «Annulla il passaggio» (cancel the transfer) («I saldi del Wallet legati a questo passaggio si tolgono: … (Gestione ordinaria)») (the Wallet balances linked to this transfer are removed: … (Gestione ordinaria)), the sentences of the settlement management by management, the note that the collections page writes for the extra part on another management («… — Gestione ordinaria, scelta dall'amministratore») (… — Gestione ordinaria, chosen by the administrator) and the sentence of the same page («È una rata della Gestione ordinaria: la parte in più passa a quella gestione.») (it is an instalment of the Gestione ordinaria: the extra part goes to that management). The collection notes already written stay as they were.

THE GUIDES — The guide «Guida: registrare un passaggio» (guide: recording a transfer) says when the history of the first sale says how much has passed to the second (when the part resold comes from that sale alone, and not when whoever resells has bought from several people or has in the same row also a part received with the succession: there the program does not divide the figure between the origins, and the resale says at whose charge what remains is) and that the second sale of the only heir of whoever had sold to them is theirs, with the Wallet, like the stop of an heir who bought nothing, while with more than one heir it stays at the charge of all of them, or of whoever resells if the stop of the first sale has already been settled, without the Wallet. The guide «Guida: ruoli e usufrutto» (guide: roles and usufruct) says that a role entered with a zero share does not pay and passes the item to the next role in the chain, and that its row counts only as a row closed the day before another one of the same role, which then applies from its own start date; it no longer says that it «conta come assente» (counts as absent).

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) Transfers already recorded from beta.50 to beta.53 are not corrected by themselves: a creation, a reserve or an extinction of the usufruct on a split unit after «Scrivi il conguaglio», the sales recorded after them, the resale of an heir who had also bought, and a sale after a stop at the charge of several people keep in their record what was written then (for an extinction, no stop), and the transfers you record after them read it as it is. If the transfer is the last one on the unit and the unit's history lets you cancel it, cancel it and record it again; if it does not (for example because a plan has already taken its settlement or its linked balances), the history says what to do first, or the Wallet way remains. From the Wallet correct the linked rows you recorded following the sentence of then; after an extinction that said nothing, if those days go to whoever became full owner again, record yourself the balances linked to the extinction (in the example of the extinction, € 45.37 credit to Ugo and € 45.37 debit to Elsa). (2) The history of the first sale says how much has passed to the second only if the part resold comes from that sale alone; it does not say it when whoever resells has bought from several people, has in the same row also a part received with the succession, or is the only heir of whoever had sold to them, and the resale says at whose charge what remains is. (3) If the succession leaves the arrears in the deceased's name and you choose «Non scriverlo» (do not write it), the resale of the heir who had also bought a part puts the whole figure at the charge of whoever sold to them: in the example of Ugo, Anna and Bruno, the sentence says «€ 19,11 restano a carico di Anna, o di Bruno se la fermata della vendita del 1 ottobre 2026 è già stata regolata» (€ 19.11 stay at the charge of Anna, or of Bruno if the stop of the sale of 1 October 2026 has already been settled), but € 11.47 comes from the inherited part, whose days are in the deceased's row, which with «Non scriverlo» stays with him. (4) If someone who already has their part of the pair buys another share from someone who did not have it, that purchase writes no stop: with Ugo at 75 % and Anna at 25 %, if Anna sells to Elsa on 1 October and Elsa sells to Ugo on 1 November, € 15.04 of the days stay in Anna's row (or pass to Elsa, if the stop of the first sale has been settled from the Wallet) and the program does not say so. (5) For the heir it is the same cause: if they buy a share from someone who did not have the pair and then resell, the resale finds no earlier stop and the stop is theirs, with the Wallet. With two heirs the sentence names only whoever resells, and if the share bought belonged to a living person the figure is not put at that person's charge. (6) If the deceased had received a part with a stop (for example from the extinction of a usufruct, which stopped the days at the usufructuary's charge) and their heir resells, the sentence puts the whole figure at the heir's charge, including the part that is in the usufructuary's row. (7) If the earlier stop at the charge of several people was recorded before beta.53, the record of then does not say who those people are, and the sale that follows still puts it at the charge of the whole pair.
